name: DXN Holdings Bhd.
overview: 2026年，DXN 在巴西 Ibia 落实工业厂房用地捐赠协议，并与委内瑞拉 La Guaira 经济特区签署谅解备忘录探索可持续农业、水产养殖及清真生态；同时终止 Gulfstream G550 包机安排，并完成多家印尼休眠子公司及韩国子公司的自愿清盘。
overview_en: In 2026, DXN completed a land donation agreement for an industrial plant in Ibia, Brazil, and signed an MOU with La Guaira Special Economic Zone in Venezuela to explore sustainable agriculture, aquaculture and Halal ecosystem development; it also terminated the Gulfstream G550 charter arrangement and completed voluntary winding-up of several dormant Indonesian subsidiaries and its Korean subsidiary.

segments.name: 健康与保健消费品
segments.note: 今年推进巴西工业厂房用地落实，并探索委内瑞拉农业与水产养殖合作。
segments.note_en: This year the segment progressed the Brazil industrial plant land arrangement and explored agriculture and aquaculture cooperation in Venezuela.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与委内瑞拉 La Guaira 经济特区签署谅解备忘录，探索可持续农业、水产养殖、农产品加工及制造和清真生态系统发展方面的战略合作。
actions.text_en: Entered into an MOU with La Guaira Special Economic Zone in Venezuela to explore strategic cooperation in sustainable agriculture, aquaculture, agro-processing and manufacturing, and Halal ecosystem development.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 DXN Marketing (Brasil) LTDA 与 Ibia 市政府签署互惠承诺协议，市政府捐赠一幅土地用于建设工业厂房。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary DXN Marketing (Brasil) LTDA entered into a Reciprocal Commitment Agreement with the Municipality of Ibia, under which the Municipality donates a parcel of land for the construction of an industrial plant.

segments.name: 其他非报告分部
segments.note: 今年终止 Gulfstream G550 包机安排，并清盘多家休眠子公司。
segments.note_en: This year the segment terminated the Gulfstream G550 charter arrangement and wound up several dormant subsidiaries.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接子公司 PT Daxen KJP Agro 于 2026 年 10 月 29 日启动成员自愿清盘，该公司目前休眠。
actions.text_en: Indirect subsidiary PT Daxen KJP Agro commenced members' voluntary winding-up on 29 October 2026; the company is currently dormant.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接子公司 PT Daxen Agri Pratama 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日启动成员自愿清盘，该公司目前休眠。
actions.text_en: Indirect subsidiary PT Daxen Agri Pratama commenced members' voluntary winding-up on 28 September 2026; the company is currently dormant.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 子公司 PT. Daxen Agrotech Nusantara 于 2026 年 8 月 27 日启动成员自愿清盘，该公司目前休眠。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary PT. Daxen Agrotech Nusantara commenced members' voluntary winding-up on 27 August 2026; the company is currently dormant.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 DXN Korea Co., Ltd. 于 2026 年 5 月 12 日提交解散登记申请，该公司自 2021 年起已无运营。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary DXN Korea Co., Ltd. submitted an application for dissolution registration on 12 May 2026; the company has been operationally inactive since 2021.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: DXN Aero Nautic Sdn Bhd 与包机承运方及管理方于 2026 年 5 月 29 日协议终止 Gulfstream G550 包机，2026 年 5 月 31 日生效。
actions.text_en: DXN Aero Nautic Sdn Bhd, the charter carrier and charter manager mutually agreed on 29 May 2026 to terminate the Gulfstream G550 charter, effective 31 May 2026.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 与委内瑞拉 La Guaira 经济特区签署谅解备忘录，探索可持续农业、水产养殖、农产品加工及制造和清真生态系统发展，属于此前未覆盖的新业务领域。
model_changes.text_en: Signed an MOU with La Guaira Special Economic Zone in Venezuela to explore sustainable agriculture, aquaculture, agro-processing and manufacturing, and Halal ecosystem development, representing new business areas not previously covered.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 终止 Gulfstream G550 包机安排，退出该飞机包机相关安排。
model_changes.text_en: Terminated the Gulfstream G550 charter arrangement, exiting the aircraft charter-related arrangement.
